outline:
It's an EMI (English as a medium of instruction) course.

This course focuses on the synthesis and characterization of materials, including gas-phase and solution-phase reactions. The core contents of the course are:
(1) Various solution-phase synthesis of nanopowders, hollow nanospheres and nanowires
(2) Synthesis of nanotubes and nanowires by gas-phase reaction
(3) Nano-Imprint Lithography
(4) Nanomaterials analysis technology
schedule:
1.	Introduction to Nanomaterials Synthesis
2-3	Solid-State Reactions
3-5	Formation of Solids from the Gas Phase
6-7	Formation of Solids from Solutions and Melts
8	Midterm
9	Physical Chemistry of Solid Surfaces
10-11 Zero-Dimensional Nanostructures: Nanoparticles
12-13 One-Dimensional Nanostructures: Nanowires & Nanorods
14-15 Two-Dimensional Nanostructures: Thin Films & Special Nanomaterials
16    Final

category: 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查(Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
flexible_learning.content:
閱讀與課程內容相關之研究論文，並繳交心得報告，內容應包括論文主要研究內容、數據分析、研究成果，以及其對科學研究之主要貢獻等。

Students are required to read research papers related to the course and submit a report summarizing the main research content, data analysis, key findings, and major scientific contributions of the selected papers.
flexible_learning.outcome:
學生須繳交報告並依報告內容進行評分，占學期總成績之 20%。

Students are required to submit the report for evaluation, which accounts for 10% of the final course grade.
